review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cluster to Cluster Synchronization, Migration Tooling
review_candidates.description: The Cluster to Cluster Synchronization team is working to make migrations, backups, and disaster recovery of MongoDB clusters easy and reliable. Our main focus is mongosync, a tool to synchronize two MongoDB clusters. This tool is a top priority for the company, and is used to migrate customers from on-prem MongoDB to MongoDB's cloud service, MongoDB Atlas. Our team champions a strong culture of inclusivity and collaboration. If you want to work on a collaborative team that’s creating a high-performance distributed service for syncing databases, this is the team for you! We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model. Responsibilities Build mongosync, a database migration and syncing tool. This tool is heavily used by MongoDB Atlas (our Database-as-a-Service), as well as by on-prem customers Develop the MongoDB Database Tools, a set of CLI utilities for working with a MongoDB deployment. It includes tools for importing, exporting, and diagnostics Work closely with product, support, and engineers across the organization to collectively build features that our customers love Mentor and contribute to the growth of team members Candidate Profile 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, testing, and maintaining industrial-strength software Experience with building databases or core components for data processing systems Experience with distributed systems such as data replication, distributed transactions, scalability, and fault tolerance Experience in at least one compiled language, and interest in working with Go Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills and a desire to collaborate with colleagues and mentor junior engineers Curiosity, willingness, and ability to quickly learn new things in the domains of computer science and software engineering Success Measures In three months you’ll have learned about how MongoDB and mongosync works. You’ll have contributed to an ongoing project and fixed a few bugs in existing code In six months, you’ll be reviewing code and new feature designs. You're involved in the design and implementation of a major project, and leading development of smaller features In twelve months, you’re leading the design and development of major new features and are helping to mentor new engineers on the team. You have strong familiarity with the products the team owns and are able to work across the codebase About MongoDB MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software. Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. review_candidates.title: Data Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Data Engineer - Azure & Machine Learning (Mid-Level) Location: Portugal Work Model: Full-time & Remote About Us MOZAYDO was built by people who believe work should feel human - even when powered by technology. We’re a remote-first company that connects talent, technology, and purpose to help companies grow sustainably. We also believe recruitment should be more than matching keywords to job descriptions. It's about understanding people, recognising potential, and creating the right conditions for long-term success. Here, ownership matters more than control, and progress matters more than perfection. People powered, tech enabled. About the Role We're looking for someone who can bring their expertise, ambition, and unique perspective to one of the project teams we support. At MOZAYDO, we believe great careers are built where talent, purpose, and opportunity meet. While we're currently hiring for a specific project environment, our focus goes beyond matching skills to requirements. We want to understand where you can create the most impact and continue growing. In this role, you will build data solutions on Microsoft Azure and contribute to traditional Machine Learning projects, including classification, regression, clustering and/or time-series forecasting. Working with business stakeholders, Data Scientists and technical teams, you will help prepare data, train and evaluate models, and integrate them into production pipelines. Responsibilities Gather and analyse requirements with business and technical teams. Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks, PySpark and, where applicable, Azure Data Factory. Implement data ingestion, transformation and modelling within Data Lakehouse architectures. Prepare datasets for Machine Learning, including data cleaning, missing-value handling and feature engineering. Contribute to model development, training and evaluation, selecting metrics appropriate to the business problem. Implement batch inference and scoring pipelines, integrating model outputs into data processes. Monitor data quality and model performance in production. Apply good practices in version control, documentation, testing and software development. Requirements Mid-Level: 2-3 years of experience in Data Engineering, including participation in traditional Machine Learning projects. Strong practical experience with Azure Databricks. Good knowledge of Python, SQL and PySpark. Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage, Parquet and Delta Lake. Experience across the data solution lifecycle: ingestion, transformation, modelling and delivery. Hands-on experience with Machine Learning libraries, data preparation, feature engineering, model training, validation and evaluation. Understanding of overfitting, data leakage, train/test separation and cross-validation. Experience integrating models into data processing and batch scoring pipelines. Experience with Git and good software engineering practices. Ability to develop scalable solutions with attention to performance and execution costs. Analytical thinking, autonomy, attention to detail and the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Native Portuguese; intermediate English. Nice to have: Azure Machine Learning, including training jobs/pipelines, model registration and inference endpoints. Azure Data Factory. Model monitoring, data drift detection and retraining processes. Model deployment through APIs or online endpoints. Unity Catalog, data governance and access control. Scrum, Jira and Confluence. Hiring Process Our hiring process is designed to help both sides make an informed decision and ensure the best possible match between your experience, aspirations, and the project environment. Please note that the process may vary depending on the complexity and specific requirements of each opportunity. Initial Conversation with Us: a first discussion focused on understanding your background, strengths, motivations, and the type of environment where you can thrive and create the greatest impact. Project Team Qualification: a conversation with the project team to explore the role, responsibilities, expectations, and mutual alignment. Role-Specific Evaluation (when applicable): depending on the position, this stage may include technical assessments, practical exercises, certification validation, personality assessments, security clearance requirements, or other evaluation methods relevant to the role. Final Alignment Meeting: a final conversation to ensure expectations are aligned on both sides and that, if we move forward together, we start with clarity, confidence, and shared objectives.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer 3
review_candidates.description: The Kubernetes teams make running MongoDB in and from Kubernetes so frictionless that it is the default database choice for cloud-native applications. Our operators let developers and platform teams provision, scale and operate MongoDB through Kubernetes-native APIs, in their own clusters or in MongoDB Atlas. You will join the Kubernetes Capabilities squad. Our sister squad builds the shared platform layer of the MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes; we build the capabilities on top of it that users actually adopt. That means bringing MongoDB features such as Search and Vector Search to Kubernetes, extending what our users can deploy and manage declaratively, and owning the Atlas Kubernetes Operator. Our work starts with a user problem and ends with a Kubernetes API that solves it. In practice, we build a platform for other engineers. Our users are developers and platform teams who expect self-service, sensible defaults and APIs that behave predictably. If you have built an internal developer platform, a Kubernetes controller, or any system whose customers are other engineers, you will recognise the problems we work on. No prior experience with MongoDB is required. You will meet most of the team during interviews, and we pride ourselves on being an inclusive, collaborative group that Builds Together. Our core engineering values are Context, Predictability, Transparency, Focus and Craftsmanship. This role can be based in our Dublin office, Cork office or remotely within Ireland. The role We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Kubernetes Capabilities squad and help decide which MongoDB capabilities our users get on Kubernetes and how they work. You will own significant capabilities from design to production, make sound technical decisions under ambiguity, and raise the engineering bar of the team through design, review and mentorship. Experience we value What matters most is that you have built platforms, not only operated them. We value experience from any of these backgrounds: Building Kubernetes controllers, operators, CRDs, admission webhooks or other extensions against the Kubernetes API Building internal developer platforms: self-service provisioning, golden paths, platform APIs, CLIs or developer portals used by other engineering teams Building developer-facing infrastructure products such as SDKs, managed services, CI/CD systems or cloud provisioning tooling Responsibilities Lead the design and delivery of new capabilities in our Kubernetes operators, from technical design through production support Work with Product and the teams behind MongoDB features to turn them into Kubernetes-native APIs our users can adopt Write technical designs that weigh trade-offs clearly and bring the team and stakeholders to a decision Shape our platform APIs with our users in mind: predictable, self-service and safe to operate Mentor engineers through pairing, code review and design feedback Partner with our platform squad, Support, Docs and other engineering teams, and help resolve complex customer issues Improve how the team works, including testing strategy, release quality and developer experience Requirements Strong core software engineering skills and several years building production software in a modern language; we mostly use Go Proven experience building a platform for other engineers, such as Kubernetes controllers and operators, an internal developer platform, or developer-facing infrastructure products Deep working knowledge of Kubernetes, including its API model, reconciliation and the operational realities of running workloads on it Experience designing, testing and operating distributed systems in production A track record of leading projects through ambiguity and delivering them end to end Strong written communication, including technical design documents Nice to have Experience with controller-runtime, kubebuilder or contributing to Kubernetes ecosystem projects Experience with multi-cluster Kubernetes, networking or service mesh Experience running stateful workloads or databases on Kubernetes Experience with a major public cloud provider What is in it for you Generous compensation package (top-range salary, equity, comprehensive benefits) A diverse, highly collaborative team that values shipping fast and clean Time to learn on the job and grow into new technologies A high level of independence, focused on results rather than the appearance of work About MongoDB MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software. Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. review_candidates.title: Furniture Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: This ideal candidate will partner with Account Executives to find, contact, and follow-up with prospective clients. Once they discover the client's needs, they will discuss our product's technological capabilities and business value with the client. The ideal candidate should be able to clearly articulate highly technical concepts to all prospective clients.    Responsibilities Manage B2C and B2B sales. Understand client’s vision and interpret into the suitable selection with focus on furniture, carpet, lighting, artwork and accessories. Communicate with clients online and offline, prepare financial proposals, and follow up on orders. Coordinate with production, marketing and finance departments. Develop 2D plans and mood boards when necessary. Develop 2D and 3D for new products when necessary. Vendor acquisition as per the business needs when necessary. Confirm orders with customers and prepare their job orders for production and sourcing. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in a related design field. 1-3 years of sales and design experience. Excellent command of English language. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Proficiency in AutoCAD and Photoshop; 3D Max is a plus. Preferred experience in the furniture industry. Creative with strong design and presentation skills. Initiative-driven with project management abilities. Meticulous, team player, able to work under pressure. Excellent problem-solving skills.

review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer
review_candidates.description: At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same. Location This role is remote based in Canada About The Job You Are Considering We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with 5+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems to support the ingestion, processing, storage, and lifecycle management of user- and listing-generated media across a global platform. This role will drive platform modernization initiatives, lead complex migration efforts, and ensure media services meet the highest standards of reliability, scalability, privacy, and compliance Your role Lead end-to-end migration of legacy media processing platforms, including architecture design, data modeling, backfill strategies, phased cutovers, and legacy system decommissioning. Design and develop event-driven media processing pipelines using Kafka and asynchronous workflows to support scalable, reliable, and fault-tolerant services. Build and maintain media ingestion, processing, storage, and lifecycle management solutions for images, videos, and documents. Implement privacy, trust, and compliance controls, including GDPR-compliant data deletion, content validation, and secure handling of user-generated content. Develop and support integrations with third-party media processing and transcoding providers, including webhook management, error handling, and operational monitoring. Design and enhance APIs, GraphQL services, and data models while ensuring scalability, consistency, backward compatibility, and high performance. Must Have Skills 5+ years of backend software engineering experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production environments. Strong expertise in Java and Kotlin backend development, microservices architecture, and service-to-service integrations. Proven experience with event-driven architectures, including Kafka, asynchronous processing, workflow orchestration, and distributed systems design. Experience leading large-scale platform migrations, including cutover planning, backfills, rollback strategies, and schema evolution. Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, data modeling, change data capture (CDC), and data lifecycle management. Experience with caching technologies such as Redis, cache invalidation strategies, and high-performance backend systems. Strong operational and troubleshooting experience, including production support, monitoring, alerting, incident response, runbook creation, and service reliability engineering. Experience building or supporting media processing platforms, content management systems, transcoding workflows, CDN integrations, or content safety solutions. review_candidates.title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: We are not accepting applicants requiring a VISA at this stage. Overview We’re seeking a seasoned Senior Robotics Software Engineer to lead the design, development, and deployment of advanced robotic systems. In this role, you’ll shape core software architecture, guide technical strategy, and collaborate across disciplines to bring intelligent, reliable, and scalable robotic solutions to life. You’ll work at the intersection of autonomy, perception, and real-time systems, helping push the boundaries of what our robots can understand and achieve. Key Responsibilities  Architect, implement, and optimize software for autonomous robotic platforms, including perception, planning, and control modules.  Lead end-to-end development cycles from prototyping and simulation to field testing and production deployment.  Collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers to integrate software with hardware components.  Drive code quality through rigorous testing, code reviews, and continuous improvement practices.  Mentor junior engineers and contribute to long-term technical roadmaps.  Evaluate emerging technologies, tools, and frameworks to enhance system performance and reliability. Qualifications  Extensive experience developing robotics software in C++, Python, or similar languages.  Strong background in algorithms for perception, SLAM, motion planning, or control.  Hands-on experience with ROS or ROS2, real-time systems, and simulation environments such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim.  Solid understanding of robotics fundamentals, including kinematics, dynamics, and sensor fusion.  Proven ability to lead complex technical projects and collaborate in multidisciplinary teams.  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; PhD is a plus. What We’re Looking For A creative problem solver with 5+ years industrial experience in a relevant field, who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys tackling hard technical challenges, and brings both depth and breadth in robotics. Someone who can balance big-picture thinking with meticulous engineering and who’s excited to help shape the next generation of intelligent machines.
